heading: ## Purpose
reason: Realized by the JSONL substrate: appended work-items land as plain-text JSON lines recoverable with a plain reader — the 'no embedded database, readable with cat' property the Purpose section rests on. Control-armed: a non-plaintext substrate would not round-trip through json.loads over the raw lines.

heading: ## Scope boundary
reason: RESIDUAL (glossary/meta — no enforcing check, no runtime behavior). This heading is an authoring rule for the spec document: the SPECIFICATION MUST NOT re-state livespec's contract, MUST concretize for the JSONL substrate, and points upstream, with the pin moving in a discrete bump-pin PR. No mechanical check enforces 'do not restate upstream' and the rule governs prose, not code. Recommended for spec-restructure (fold into a testable contracts.md clause or accept as permanent glossary residual).

heading: ## Terminology
reason: Realized by the latest-record-wins / supersession-chain reduction the Terminology section defines: the materialized view is the supersession-chain head per id. Control-armed by test_store: the head-wins assertion fails if the reduction picks a superseded record.

heading: ## Substrate properties
reason: Realized by the store reader enforcing the substrate properties (one JSON object per line, no empty lines between records, trailing newline). Control-armed by test_store: an empty line between records raises rather than parsing.

heading: ## Lifecycle and evolution
reason: RESIDUAL (enforced by core doctor-static; not pytest-mappable). The livespec-lifecycle structure this heading describes IS enforced against THIS repo by the check-doctor-static aggregate member (findings doctor-proposed-changes-and-history-dirs, doctor-version-directories-complete, doctor-version-contiguity, doctor-revision-to-proposed-change-pairing, doctor-accept-decision-snapshot-consistency, doctor-out-of-band-edits — all `pass` on this repo). It cannot be re-bound to a pytest conformance test here: the doctor_static runner ships in the livespec CORE plugin (resolved from the plugin cache, no stable importable module in this repo) and tests-no-subprocess-spawn forbids invoking it as a subprocess. Maintainer disposition: allow a heading to map to an armed check_id/recipe, or make the core doctor checks importable in-process.

heading: ## What this spec is not
reason: RESIDUAL (glossary/meta — no enforcing check, no runtime behavior). This heading is negative scoping of the spec document (not a re-statement of livespec's contract, not a Python implementation manual, not a substitute for the upstream invariant catalog). It asserts no mechanically-checkable rule and no runtime behavior. Recommended for spec-restructure or acceptance as permanent glossary residual.

heading: ## The seven-skill surface
reason: Realized by the shipped skills tree: each of the seven required skills (four heavyweight authored + three thin-transport) ships a SKILL.md under .claude-plugin/skills/. Control-armed: a dropped skill directory fails the test.

heading: ## Plugin namespace
reason: Realized by .claude-plugin/plugin.json, which fixes the /livespec-orchestrator-git-jsonl: namespace the cross-boundary invariants invoke through. Control-armed: a renamed manifest fails the name assertion.

heading: ## Work-items JSONL record schema
reason: Realized by the store codec: an appended record serializes exactly the canonical key set and no extra keys. Control-armed by test_store, which pins the serialized key set of an appended record.

heading: ## Spec Reader internal API
reason: Realized by the Spec Reader module's read_current_specification capability, which exposes only ratified canonical content and excludes proposed_changes. Control-armed by test_spec_reader: a proposed-changes file must not appear in the current snapshot.

heading: ## Persistent Agent Knowledge realization
reason: RESIDUAL (enforced by core doctor-static; not pytest-mappable). The .ai/<topic>.md reference-resolution this heading realizes IS enforced against THIS repo by the check-doctor-static finding doctor-agents-ai-reference-resolution (`pass` — this repo currently declares zero .ai topic references, so the invariant holds vacuously). Same blocker as Lifecycle: the doctor_static runner is CORE-owned (no stable importable module) and subprocess is banned in tests, so it cannot be re-bound to a pytest conformance test here. Maintainer disposition as above.

heading: ## Cross-boundary handoffs
reason: Conformance: runs the skill-invocation-paths check-runner against THIS repo (clean) and against a control-armed fixture whose SKILL.md hard-codes an `uv run .claude-plugin/scripts/bin/*.py` wrapper-path shell-out (reddens) — realizing the handoff-mechanism rule that skills are invoked through the canonical namespace/plugin-root form, never a direct shell-out to a wrapper path.

heading: ## `compat` block
reason: RESIDUAL (not applicable to this repo + core-enforced). This repo's own .livespec.jsonc declares a livespec-orchestrator-beads-fabro backend, so it ships NO livespec-orchestrator-git-jsonl compat block — there is no this-repo git-jsonl compat block to conformance-test. The block's validity IS enforced against consumers by the core doctor-static finding doctor-livespec-jsonc-valid (and the upstream contract-version-compatibility invariant), neither of which is importable in-process here nor subprocess-invocable under the test ban. Maintainer disposition: this is a consumer-side contract; converge via a consumer-repo conformance test or a heading-to-check_id mapping.

heading: ## Inherited from livespec
reason: Realized by the packaging posture the inherited constraints require: no PyPI runtime dependencies are declared and libraries are vendored under .claude-plugin/scripts/_vendor/. Control-armed: a populated dependencies array or a missing vendor tree fails the test.

heading: ## JSONL substrate constraints
reason: Realized by the store reader enforcing the exact-schema JSONL substrate constraint: records with keys beyond the canonical schema are rejected. Control-armed by test_store: an extra key raises a schema violation.

heading: ## Process boundaries
reason: Realized by the .gitattributes '*.jsonl merge=union' entry: the plugin adds no lockfile, so git commit/merge serialization is the conflict-resolution boundary for concurrent appends. Control-armed: removing the merge=union attribute fails the test.

heading: ## Spec Reader implementation constraints
reason: Realized by the read-only Spec Reader module honoring the implementation constraints: the current-specification read excludes history and never mutates the tree. Control-armed by test_spec_reader: history content must not appear in the current snapshot.

heading: ## Skill orchestration constraints
reason: Realized by the thin-transport wrapper layout the orchestration constraints mandate: the next skill's logic lives in .claude-plugin/scripts/bin/next.py and the SKILL.md is a pass-through. Control-armed by the bin wrapper test, which invokes the wrapper and pins its exit-code threading.

heading: ## Persistent Agent Knowledge constraints
reason: RESIDUAL (enforced by core doctor-static; not pytest-mappable). Same substance and same enforcing finding as the contracts.md 'Persistent Agent Knowledge realization' row (doctor-agents-ai-reference-resolution, `pass` on this repo). The orphan-reference / atomic-write constraints are a documentation convention enforced by CORE doctor-static, which cannot be run as an in-process pytest here (CORE-owned runner + tests-no-subprocess-spawn ban). Maintainer disposition as above.

heading: ## Forbidden patterns
reason: Conformance: runs the no-raw-store-read check-runner against THIS repo's source and asserts clean (OK) — realizing the 'read path only via the query surface / no off-substrate raw store read' forbidden pattern. The sibling tests in the same module supply control-armed violating fixtures (a literal store-basename open, a declared-path open, a builtin open of the declared name) that the check catches and reddens.

heading: ## Scenario 1 — Gap-tied fix cycle
reason: Integration-tier: exercises the gap-tied cycle end to end across the store and the next ranker — file a gap-tied ready record, confirm next surfaces it as the implement recommendation, append the completed closing record with an audit, and confirm next no longer ranks it.

heading: ## Scenario 2 — Freeform bug fix
reason: Integration-tier: exercises the freeform cycle across the store, next, and list-work-items — file a freeform ready record, confirm next ranks it, close it via the freeform path (done/completed/reason, no gap re-detection), and confirm list-work-items --filter closed surfaces it.

heading: ## Scenario 3 — Doctor cross-boundary read
reason: Integration-tier: exercises doctor's cross-boundary queries across list-work-items and detect-impl-gaps — both complete deterministically with the contract JSON shapes (an array of materialized views, and a {gap_ids: [...]} object).

heading: ## Scenario 4 — Cross-repo Layer 3 loop driver (livespec-resident)
reason: Integration-tier: exercises the Layer-2 emission the Layer-3 driver composes — with no ready work the impl-side next emits an empty candidates[] with has_more false, never a legacy single-object shape.

heading: ## Append-only store disciplines
reason: Realized by work-item livespec-impl-plaintext-lhq: the supersedes field, the sha256 per-record identity, the order-independent supersession-chain-head reduction, and the .gitattributes '*.jsonl merge=union' entry. The mapped test pins order independence; the sibling reduction tests in test_store.py cover tie-breaks, divergence surfacing, and identical-line collapse. The two store-integrity checks (no-divergent-heads, no-raw-store-read) are realized by work-items livespec-impl-git-jsonl-5ej + livespec-impl-git-jsonl-p3q: tests/livespec_orchestrator_git_jsonl/checks/ exercises both, and the checks are wired into the just check aggregate as private extras consuming the canonical reducer / query surface.

heading: ## Scenario 5 — Ledger-intent drift surfaces missing spec behavior
reason: Integration-tier: exercises the ledger-intent scan's read path across the store and the append-only materialized-view reduction — materialize the supersession-chain head and assert the store file bytes are unchanged by the read (the scan never writes work-item state).
